         5                  ACTING PRESIDENT WRIGHT:    Senator

         6       Sabini, to explain his vote.

         7                  SENATOR SABINI:    I want to

         8       commend Senator DeFrancisco on this bill that,

         9       in an earlier version, passed the Senate under

        10       Senator Spano's sponsorship.  The bill now has

        11       better definitions, increased penalties.

        12                  This is an issue that I have met

        13       with a number of groups on from my district,

        14       women from the South Asian community, women

        15       from the Southeast Asian community -- women

        16       from the Philippines, from Bangladesh, from

        17       Pakistan, from India.

        18                  And it speaks to an issue that

        19       lives in our bedrooms and living rooms that

        20       people don't want to talk about, but the abuse

        21       of workers who are not on the books who are

        22       used as domestics, whose immigration status

        23       may be questionable but whose status as human

        24       beings is no less important to them -- or to

        25       us, frankly.

         6       322, by Senator Volker, Senate Print 2373, an

         7       act to amend the Penal Law, in relation to

         8       assaults.

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT WRIGHT:    Read

        11                  THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

        17                  ACTING PRESIDENT WRIGHT:    Senator

        18       DeFrancisco, to explain his vote.

        19                  SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:    I vote yes.

        20                  But I just wanted to mention that

        21       if an assault on someone in a certain location

        22       is an assault in the second degree, it should

        23       not depend upon who that someone is.

        24                  Originally the law apparently said

        25       assault on a train operator, a ticket


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        1726



         1       inspector, conductor, signal person, et

         2       cetera, et cetera, it elevated it to a Class D

         3       felony; namely, assault in the second degree.

         4       Now we're adding station cleaner, terminal

         5       cleaner.

         6                  I just don't get it.  I mean, if

         7       it's -- I understand the need to protect these

         8       people.  But if there's a need to protect

         9       everybody that's working in this capacity in a

        10       situation where it's a subway or a train, it

        11       doesn't make much sense to me why you'd do it

        12       in a way that you name every conceivable human

        13       being that's working in that place and if you

        14       forget one, you add another one.

        15                  So I think assault in the second

        16       degree should be the penalty for anyone who

        17       commits assault in certain circumstances.  And

        18       I'll vote yes, however, but I think it's a

        19       better way to do it.

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT WRIGHT:    Senator

        21       DeFrancisco will be recorded in the

        22       affirmative.

         1                  (The Secretary called the roll.)

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT WRIGHT:    Senator

         3       Robach, to explain his vote.

         4                  SENATOR ROBACH:    Mr. President,

         5       just very briefly.  I want to applaud Senator

         6       Skelos for this bill.

         7                  Unfortunately, this is no longer a

         8       minor issue in our society.  I think we have

         9       to do all we can -- I'm someone who loves

        10       sports, loves kids, whether it's my own or

        11       coaching other children.  And I continue to be

        12       amazed that in spite of all the efforts to

        13       promote sportsmanship and civility, you know,

        14       from all parts of the country, let alone the

        15       state, we have a rising incidence of violence

        16       not by the student athletes or the players

        17       themselves, but by the parents.

        18                  And just this last month, we can no

        19       longer even have the sectionals for high

        20       school basketball at our biggest facilities,

        21       something the students look forward to,

        22       because the fans, including parents, were

        23       fighting.  We had to bring in almost the

        24       entire Rochester Police Department to break up

        25       that incident.


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        1731



         1                  And so from large-scale incidents

         2       to things you see on the news of parents

         3       charging out to beat up an official or someone

         4       who doesn't agree with them or makes a call, I

         5       think this legislation is very, very much

         6       needed, in addition to us continuing to teach

         7       our children about civility and the importance

         8       of fair play and respecting others.

         9                  Maybe we could even use a little of

        10       this in this chamber ourselves, respecting

        11       civility and other things.

        12                  But I'm very happy to vote in the

        13       affirmative and thank Senator Skelos for the

        14       bill.

        16       Robach will be recorded in the affirmative.

        20       Mr. President.

        22       affirmative and want to be recorded as such.

        23       I don't want to go through the theater of the

        24       debate that I've had through last few years

        25       with the sponsor on this.


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

                                                        1732



         1                  But I just wish we would amend this

         2       bill to include the players.  Because we've

         3       had a number of incidents where players have

         4       gone in and assaulted fans.  And I think the

         5       fans we represent deserve no less protection

         6       from some of these players.

         7                  We've had two Yankees assault one

         8       of the ground crew in Boston.  We had the

         9       horrible incident between the Pistons and the

        10       Pacers where several fans were hurt.  And then

        11       we had the dreaded attack on the Italian

        12       Sausage in Milwaukee, which I took personal

        13       affront to.

        14                  So I just wish that in the

        15       future -- and I assume this bill will again

        16       not pass the Assembly -- that we would try to

        17       find a way to protect everyone, including the

        18       spectators, who pay good money to come to

        19       these games and have been in some cases

        20       assaulted by the players.

        21                  Thank you.  I vote aye.

        23       you.  Senator Sabini will be recorded in the

        24       affirmative.
